candidate_state: released from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Release validation records a native material-only USI smoke from startpos at depth 1: bestmove 9g9f, score cp 0, nodes 90. The release fixes an aspiration-window boundary and strengthens PGO and CPU-pilot evidence without adopting a new evaluator or changing the ordinary search policy.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.4.4. PGO throughput evidence remains a separate fixed-condition performance result, not a playing-strength claim.

known_limitations: No in-house NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
New search and Lazy SMP policies without an independent H1 remain disabled-by-default experiments.
The qualified PGO throughput results apply only to their recorded Apple M4 configurations; ordinary release builds do not embed those profiles.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
